This '''farm''' was run by a group of failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==History==
During the [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|Battle of Dantooine]], the Jedi washouts were caught up in the fighting when their [[Farm/Legends|farm]] was attacked by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] launched from a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. They managed to fend off the droids until their could evacuate the residents in their [[Airship (Dantooine)|airship]].
